subject: EDIT NOTICE + interim lowering-opus: 4x MSAA admitted (one JM job per 4x pass), tile-buffer guard, MRT/MSAA compositor batching, n2mb_tile_stats in TEGU_PERF_RT; full gates blocked by api-surface mid-edit
body: Per root's MSAA item (siriChip/shadowGen/compositeSphere): (a) render_pipeline.inc l.1444 and nord2_render_pass.inc: rasterSampleCount/pass samples 4 admitted by default (TEGU_DISABLE_MSAA4 restores 1x; old TEGU_ENABLE_MSAA4 gone). (b) Root cause of the audit's 'multi-draw 4x passes re-clear': render_encoder effectiveLoad assumes a queued pass CLEAR job, so a 4x pass's 2nd draw got load 2 again; the 4x sidecar (render_encoder.inc sidecar_build msaa branch) now gives the pass's first 4x draw Clear/DontCare and every later draw 1 (counted from this pass's draw jobs on the target), q/compositorLoadAction set to match. (c) compositor_submit.inc: consecutive MRT/MSAA sidecar jobs with an identical target set (incl. sample counts and resolve records) form ONE JM job via new n2mb_draw_batch_mrt; a 4x draw that cannot join (batching off, cap, a memfetch draw) is refused by the bridge (lone 4x Load) -> command error, never a silent re-clear. (d) n2r: colour_buffer_allocation > 16384 B per 16x16 tile refused (Mesa pan_select_tile_size budget; G57-family v9 16 KiB). (e) Bridge: n2mb_tile_stats(conn,[jobs,target tiles,fragment tiles]); TEGU_PERF_RT gains tiles=jobs/target/fragment (per-window deltas) so the device run can measure #7 directly. Host: bridge test 18 PASS x3 (MSAA batch, lone 4x Load refusal, resolve mismatch, DontCare start), render oracle PASS (+tib guard); render harness gets a 3-draw 4x pass check (batch on: 1 submission chain 3; off: status 5). Blocked: render harness aborts earlier in test_blit_completeness and iOS -Werror syntax fails only in api_surface.inc/api_parallel.inc (api-surface-sonnet mid-edit); my files show no errors. Will run full gates when the tree is green. Hashes: bridge.c 5180ba85 .h c4abc8eb render.c db0a1b8c .h 6c3c074f render_pass.inc 89dcb300 compositor_submit.inc c4ced9ba render_encoder.inc 72bdafd5 render_pipeline.inc d7b22e7c compute_frontend.m a00f5e9a. Reorder census (frame_bench, TEGU_DRAW_REORDER 0/1/2): moved=0 in all scenarios (their target breaks are true dependencies), so its value is device-only.
